  "positives": [],
  "regressions": [
    "The V14 tower footings appear to float slightly higher than V12, lacking the grounded, physically fitted foundation that was previously present. The new tapered buttress piers are visually inconsistent with the original masonry style and appear as disconnected, overly rigid additions rather than integrated structural elements.",
    "The 'physically BVH-rock-fitted dressed foundations' are not convincingly rendered. The contact points between the new foundations and the terrain are too clean and lack the natural erosion, irregularity, and material variation expected in a realistic stone structure. The angular contacts and seams are more pronounced and less believable than in V12.",
    "The new elements introduce visual artifacts: the buttress piers and foundation blocks appear as if they were placed on top of the existing terrain rather than being part of the original construction. The UV scale and texture mapping on these new elements do not match the original V12, creating a mismatched, low-detail appearance that breaks immersion."
  ],
  "outstanding_defects": [
    "The new tower footings and buttress piers do not convincingly integrate with the existing masonry. They appear as unrelated, overly rigid additions rather than part of the original structure.",
    "The foundation blocks lack believable erosion, irregularity, and material variation. They appear as flat, uniform blocks rather than naturally weathered stone.",
    "The contact points between the new elements and the terrain are too clean and lack the natural imperfections expected in a realistic stone structure."
  ],
  "next_visual_edit": "Rebuild the tower footings and buttress piers using a more organic, erosion-based approach. Integrate them with the existing masonry by matching the UV scale, texture, and material properties. Add natural irregularities and wear to the foundation blocks to make them appear more grounded and realistic. Ensure the contact points between the new elements and the terrain are believable and consistent with the original V12.",
  "uncertainty": "The provided images do not contain the necessary visual evidence to confirm that the new elements are physically constructed and integrated with the existing masonry. The visual artifacts and inconsistencies suggest that the changes do not meet the required standards for visual quality and realism."
}
